## Meaning

This monitor fired because extrapolating the recent trend, the resource is projected to cross its limit inside the forecast horizon. It has NOT crossed it yet — the lead time is the point of this alert.

Query:

```
max(next_1d):forecast(avg:postgresql.connections{__SCOPE__} by {db_instance} / avg:postgresql.max_connections{__SCOPE__} by {db_instance}, 'linear', 1, interval='15m', history='1d') > 0.9
```

**Design note.** Connection exhaustion is one of the few database failures with a reliable linear ramp — forecasting it converts a 3am outage into a business-hours ticket.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-database-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-database` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `active_sessions`, `blocking_tree`, `top_queries_by_time`, `replication_state`.

Attached to the alert automatically: active sessions, blocking chain, top 10 queries, replica state.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `data-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
